request.description: A tiny eastern-facing golden hamster game sprite, seated naturally on a broad low haunch. Small round head, compact ears, cream muzzle, a single FLAT dark brown dot for an eye like a Game Boy Color overworld critter; no white in the eye. Clear small bent front paw above two distinct feet, lower body widest. Two angular teal gemstone prisms attached to the back with clear hard planar facets and no glow. Amber ochre fur, three flat color clusters, warm selective outline. Simple charming handheld console pixel art, full body with plenty of transparent padding. No gradient, blush, shine, mascot grin, floor or extra particles.

64px side-view pixel RPG sprite, a low crouched gray dwarf hamster facing right, tiny dark eye, cream muzzle, amethyst crystal cluster on its back, front and rear feet visibly separated, muted flat shading, transparent background
